turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Can I ask your advice as a mom?
As a mom, I'm asking you who entered that zero before anyone spoke to my son. You want me to tell you how to handle your own classroom? Answer my question first.
My nephew lives with me and lies about homework constantly. How do you get through to a kid like that?
Your nephew is your business, Hale. We're here about Owen, and I'm still waiting to hear who decided on that zero.
